opening.argument: The video presents an analysis of QR-code advertising, beginning with a breakdown of the Coinbase Super Bowl campaign and other brands' campaigns. The narrator explains how QR codes can help advertisers measure responses to offline ads. Within that analysis, the fifteen dollars in free Bitcoin is reported as a feature of Coinbase's campaign: scanning its code led to a signup page that required account creation by February 15th. The narrator also reports that the campaign's signup form collected personal information. Those details describe how the campaign worked; the narrator is not described as asking viewers to join that campaign. The reward and data collection are presented as subjects of the advertising breakdown, not as an offer to the audience.

citations.quote: In this video, we are breaking down the Coinbase Super Bowl QR Code campaign and some other brands who did it right with their QR Code ad campaigns!
qr codes have become a way to bridge the gap in attribution.
When scanned, the QR code led to the sign-up page offering fifteen dollars in free Bitcoin in exchange for setting up an account by February 15th.
